title: LaTeX paper as a KV-cache tree
description: One parsed paper. Merge rules: MERGE_RULES.md (same folder).

n_seq.description: Sequences used: seq 0 holds only the root, groups are seqs 1..n_seq-1.

ref_stats.description: How the paper's references were handled (MERGE_RULES.md pass 4): shared, same_group, forward, unresolved, over_max_refs, duplicate_labels.

nodes.description: Pre-order (document order). nodes[i].id == i; nodes[0] is the document.

node_type.description: document/section/subsection/subsubsection are containers (no tokens); the rest are leaves.

parent.description: id of the containing node; null for the document

text.description: the leaf's LaTeX source, verbatim; empty for containers

tokens.description: token ids; only the root starts with BOS

positions.description: one per token, counted per sequence

seq_ids.description: root: every seq. Other leaves: [home seq, then seqs that receive it via seq_cp]. Containers: [].

n_markup.description: how many of this leaf's tokens are pure markup
